messages.subject: Final report - MS-72 seal failure analysis (TTL-25-0417)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

My final report is ready (ref TTL-25-0417, dated 12 September). Headline findings: antimony impregnation measured 3.2-5.1% against a required 10-14%; flatness of a substantial proportion of faces outside two light bands, several beyond six; and failure surfaces showing thermal/adhesive distress, not abrasive contamination. My conclusion is that the failures were caused by the seals as manufactured, and that the deficiencies are systemic. I'll send the signed PDF separately.

Best,
Helen
